label: Album Cover
description: A square-format record cover: subject via {trigger}, carried entirely by aesthetic, palette and print treatment.
prefix: An iconic album cover design, square format — the kind of image that defines a record's whole identity. Central concept: {trigger}.

variables.name: trigger
variables.label: Cover concept / subject
variables.default: a lone figure walking into blinding light

suffix: Cover Standard: instantly iconic at thumbnail size and rich at full bleed, deliberate negative space for the artist name, no lettering rendered — the image alone carries the record.
negative: text, lettering, typography, watermark, cluttered composition
